title: Divide the Villages
statementMd:
You have found $N$ villages that are all connected by $N - 1$ roads so that one can start at any village and visit any other village using these roads. However, the villagers in these villages don't want to be all connected because they think there are too many people competing over trading. So they ask for your help to break the villages up by removing roads.

Each road $i$ has a time $t_i$ that it takes to remove, but you only have $T$ time before your mom tells you to stop gaming. Therefore, **the total time of the roads you remove must be at most** $T$. Also, after removing roads, the villages are split into smaller communities where villages within a community can still visit each other using roads, but villages in different communities cannot visit each other anymore. To keep the villagers as happy as possible, you want to minimize the number of villages in the largest community. Help the villagers out as much as possible using your limited gaming time and **find the minimum number of villages in the largest community**!

## Input

The first line of input contains two integers $N$ and $T$ ($2 \le N \le 1000$, $1\le T\le 10^9$): the number of villages and the amount of gaming time you have, respectively.

The $i$-th of the next $N - 1$ lines contains three integers $u, v, t_i$ ($1 \le u, v\le N$, $u\neq v$, $1\le t_i\leq 10^9$): road $i$ is between village $u$ and village $v$ and takes time $t_i$ to remove.

## Output

Output a single integer: the minimum number of villages in the largest community after removing the optimal roads using your limited gaming time.

## Note

For the first test case, you can remove roads $1$, $2$, and $4$, which takes a total time of $6$. Then, the communities would be villages $(1)$, $(2,3)$, $(4)$, and $(5)$. So, the largest community has $2$ villages, and we can show that no other removal of roads can result in a smaller size of the largest community.

For the second test case, it is impossible to remove any of the roads without going over your given gaming time. So, all the villages will remain connected and the largest community has size $5$.
statementZhMd:
你发现了 $N$ 个村庄，它们由 $N - 1$ 条道路相连。从任意一个村庄出发，都可以沿着这些道路到达其他任意一个村庄。不过，村民们觉得参与贸易竞争的人太多了，不希望所有村庄都连在一起。于是，他们请你拆除一些道路，把这些村庄分开。

拆除第 $i$ 条道路需要花费 $t_i$ 的时间，但在妈妈叫你别玩游戏之前，你只有 $T$ 的时间。因此，**你拆除道路所花费的总时间不得超过** $T$。拆除道路后，村庄会被划分成若干个较小的社区。同一社区内的村庄仍能沿道路互相到达，不同社区的村庄则无法互相到达。为了让村民们尽可能满意，你希望最大的社区所包含的村庄数尽可能少。请在有限的游戏时间内尽力帮助村民，**求最大的社区所包含的村庄数的最小值**！

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $N$ 和 $T$（$2 \le N \le 1000$，$1\le T\le 10^9$），分别表示村庄的数量和你可以玩游戏的时间。

接下来的 $N - 1$ 行中，第 $i$ 行包含三个整数 $u, v, t_i$（$1 \le u, v\le N$，$u\neq v$，$1\le t_i\leq 10^9$），表示第 $i$ 条道路连接村庄 $u$ 和村庄 $v$，拆除它需要花费 $t_i$ 的时间。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示在有限的游戏时间内选择最优方案拆除道路后，最大的社区所包含的村庄数的最小值。

## 说明

对于第一个测试用例，你可以拆除第 $1$、$2$ 和 $4$ 条道路，总共花费 $6$ 的时间。此时，各社区包含的村庄分别为 $(1)$、$(2,3)$、$(4)$ 和 $(5)$。因此，最大的社区包含 $2$ 个村庄。可以证明，没有其他拆除方案能让最大的社区包含更少的村庄。

对于第二个测试用例，拆除任何一条道路都会超出给定的游戏时间。因此，所有村庄仍然连通，最大的社区包含 $5$ 个村庄。
